## Purpose
`/admin/roles/$id`: the role editor. It creates or edits a custom role (name, description, permissions grouped by area) and deletes it.

## Responsibilities
`RoleEditorPage`:
- reads `adminApi.role`, `permissions` and `roles` (to copy from);
- `createRole` or `updateRole`;
- `deleteRole` (toast "Role deleted");
- permission checkboxes by group;
- titled "Role — Admin console".

## Key elements
`RoleEditorPage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
Role changes.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/admin/roles` and `/permissions`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- System roles are presumably read-only; the server enforces it.

## Nuances and gotchas
None noted.
